_comment: Phases are evaluated in order against the local (Europe/London) wall clock; the first window containing 'now' wins, and the windows must tile the whole day. kelvin is RENDERED to RGB because these strips have no white channel. bri is a SHARE of what each WLED unit can really deliver (255 = its ABL ceiling for that colour; gardenroom.py converts per unit), NOT raw WLED bri - raw values above ~45-80 all hit the power limiter and looked identical. bri_white is the BanlanX SP630E (mono white, via HA): the room's only real white, so full for work, 0 = off in the evening so it adds no blue-ish light before bed. 'working': true marks the daytime task-light tiers that `gardenroom.py white` may land on. Values follow research/FINDINGS.md (EN 12464-1 + Brown et al. 2020); edit freely, the script has no times baked in.
